i1.b1: Planning, deployment, administration, and migration of Windows Server and Linux infrastructures for business customers.
i1.b2: Implementation and management of Microsoft Hyper-V environments, including physical hosts, virtual machines, virtual networking, and storage configuration.
i1.b3: Administration of Windows Server environments, including Active Directory (AD DS), Group Policy (GPO), file servers, Remote Desktop Services (RDS), DNS, and DHCP.
i1.b4: Deployment and administration of Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, identity and access management, and tenant migrations.
i1.b5: Configuration and maintenance of network infrastructure, including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, VPN connectivity, and firewall policies.
i1.b6: Administration of Veeam Backup & Replication, including backup configuration, monitoring, and system recovery.
i1.b7: Deployment and maintenance of Linux-based web and database servers, Docker environments, and automation using PowerShell and Bash.
i1.b8: Troubleshooting complex infrastructure incidents, executing system migrations, and providing technical support to German-speaking business customers.

i2.b1: Design and development of full-stack web applications using TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Vue.js.
i2.b2: Development of REST APIs, backend services, and PostgreSQL databases, including database schema design and integration.
i2.b3: Deployment and administration of containerized applications using Docker, Docker Compose, and Linux-based hosting environments.
i2.b4: Configuration and management of hosting infrastructure on Hetzner and AWS, including web servers, reverse proxies, SSL/TLS certificates, and DNS.
i2.b5: Implementation of CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, with a focus on automated builds, deployments, and application maintenance.

body.p1: My name is Lazar Vujović. I live and work in Serbia, and I have over 7 years of experience planning, implementing, and managing complex IT infrastructures for business customers. My focus is Windows Server, virtualization, Microsoft 365, Linux, and networking.
body.p2: At ITM GmbH in Rosenheim I work as a System & Network Administrator. I deliver infrastructure projects on my own, including Hyper-V, Active Directory, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, networks and firewalls, and Veeam Backup & Replication. A large part of the work is server migrations, complex incident troubleshooting, and direct support for German-speaking customers.
body.p3: Since 2023 I have also worked freelance on full-stack web applications with TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Vue.js, including REST APIs and PostgreSQL. I deploy them with Docker on Linux, host them on Hetzner and AWS, and automate builds and releases with GitHub Actions.
